body:
Well, to tell you the truth, nothing overly special has come out of this experiment, nothing spiritual, nothing philosophical, or anything of the sort.  The two substances, which had never been mentioned mixed together melded quite nicely.  To my person experiences with DPT, I am not too sensitive, and get colourful, visual distortions and things of the sort, focusing on more of a purple and green under-color.  This blended in quite well with the typical mushroom visuals to produce a trip which was quite pleasent, and quite mellow.  Quite enjoyable to me.
At points it seemed the DPT had simply acted as a potentiator to the mushrooms, produced levels of visual distortion equal to my 4 gram experience, with the mind-fuck of 2.25 grams of mushrooms, plus the interesting attitude of thought given by DPT.  Like I said above, blended and melded beautifully!
